description: Reconcile the furniture/furnished payload schema for the document/CSV Qdrant pipeline by making `metadata.furnished` (BOOL) the single canonical field, retiring the dead `metadata.furniture` (KEYWORD) index, and aligning the runtime filter producers (FilterExtractor, QueryAnalyzer SYSTEM_PROMPT, query_filter_signal reason label) so they emit a `furnished: bool` filter that actually matches what `src/ingestion/chunker.py` writes. The standalone `apartments` collection (top-level `is_furnished` BOOL) is already consistent end-to-end and is intentionally untouched. Test-first: add failing assertions that pin the new contract, then change the production code, then update docs/QDRANT_STACK.md and the regression-guard tests. Migration is safe because `metadata.furnished` is what the chunker has been writing all along — no payload backfill is required; the only artifact left over in deployed collections is a legacy keyword index with zero hits, which docs/QDRANT_STACK.md documents how to drop manually.
steps: Read /projects/sandbox/rag/.agents/tasks/task-1401-furniture-furnished-schema/context.json end-to-end before editing. The `design_decision` field is the contract you are implementing — do not introduce a third canonical or rename `is_furnished` in the apartments lane.

(Test-first, step 1) Update tests/unit/services/test_filter_extractor.py::TestFilterExtractorFurniture: replace the 4 parametrized assertions `_ext.extract_filters(query)['furniture'] == 'Есть'` with `_ext.extract_filters(query)['furnished'] is True`. Replace `'furniture' not in _ext.extract_filters('квартира в Варне')` with `'furnished' not in _ext.extract_filters('квартира в Варне')`. Add at least two new parametrized cases for negative phrasing that must produce `furnished: False`: `'квартира без мебели'` and `'без мебели в Варне'`. Update TestFilterExtractorCombined::test_combined_price_city_furniture to assert `result['furnished'] is True` (not `result['furniture'] == 'Есть'`). Run pytest on this file alone and confirm the relevant tests now FAIL — capture this fail output as evidence for the test-first workflow.

(Test-first, step 2) Update tests/unit/services/test_query_filter_signal.py: change every parametrized `(query, reason)` row whose reason is `'furniture'` to `'furnished'` (3 occurrences across two parametrize blocks). Run pytest on this file alone and confirm the affected rows now FAIL.

(Test-first, step 3) Add a new test file tests/unit/services/test_setup_qdrant_indexes.py mirroring the mocking pattern in tests/unit/scripts/test_apartments_setup_collection.py. It must: import `telegram_bot.setup_qdrant_indexes` lazily inside the patch; mock `telegram_bot.setup_qdrant_indexes.QdrantClient`; mock `telegram_bot.setup_qdrant_indexes.BotConfig` so `qdrant_url`/`qdrant_collection`/`qdrant_api_key` resolve without env; call `setup_indexes()`; collect all `create_payload_index` calls; assert that `field_name='metadata.furnished'` was created with `field_schema is models.PayloadSchemaType.BOOL`; assert that NO call uses `field_name='metadata.furniture'`. Run pytest on this file alone and confirm it FAILS (because the legacy keyword index is still being created).

(Test-first, step 4) Add a new test file tests/unit/services/test_query_analyzer_prompt.py that imports `from telegram_bot.services.query_analyzer import SYSTEM_PROMPT` and asserts: (a) the substring `furnished` is present; (b) the substring `furniture (string)` is NOT present (case-insensitive); (c) the substring `bool` appears within 80 characters of `furnished` (use a small helper; the goal is to lock in the type spec, not to grade prose). Run pytest on this file alone and confirm it FAILS.

(Implementation, step 1) Edit telegram_bot/setup_qdrant_indexes.py: replace the dict entry `{'field_name': 'metadata.furniture', 'field_schema': models.PayloadSchemaType.KEYWORD, 'description': 'Furniture availability (Есть)'}` with `{'field_name': 'metadata.furnished', 'field_schema': models.PayloadSchemaType.BOOL, 'description': 'Furnished status (bool, canonical for document/CSV pipeline; see docs/QDRANT_STACK.md)'}`. Update the trailing print summary line that says `Furniture, year-round (keyword match)` to reflect the new schema (e.g., `Furnished (bool match), year-round (keyword match)`). Do not rewrite any unrelated entries in the same dict.

(Implementation, step 2) Edit telegram_bot/services/filter_extractor.py: in `extract_filters`, change the block that stores `filters['furniture'] = furniture` to `filters['furnished'] = furnished` and update the local variable name. Rewrite `_extract_furniture` to return `bool | None` instead of `str | None`: keep the existing positive patterns (`с\s+мебелью`, `меблирован`, `с\s+мебель`, `обставлен`) returning `True`, and add explicit negative patterns (`без\s+мебели`, `немеблирован`) returning `False`. Order the negative check before the positive check so 'без мебели' does not also match 'мебель'. Rename the method to `_extract_furnished` for symmetry with the new key, and update the single call site inside `extract_filters` to match. Update the docstring.

(Implementation, step 3) Edit telegram_bot/services/query_analyzer.py SYSTEM_PROMPT: replace the line `- furniture (string): "Есть" (если упомянута мебель)` with `- furnished (bool): true (если упомянута мебель), false (если явно указано "без мебели")`. Do not change any other prompt rules or the JSON example block unless that block contained a `furniture` key (it does not — verify by reading the SYSTEM_PROMPT text first).

(Implementation, step 4) Edit telegram_bot/services/query_filter_signal.py: rename the literal `reasons.append('furniture')` to `reasons.append('furnished')`. The regex `_FURNITURE_RE` may keep its identifier name (it describes the linguistic pattern, not the payload field) — leaving it named `_FURNITURE_RE` is acceptable and keeps the diff minimal.
(Implementation, step 5) Re-run the four test files added/updated in the test-first phase. They must now PASS. If any still fail, fix the implementation rather than the tests.

(Docs) Edit docs/QDRANT_STACK.md: in the 'Structured Catalog / CSV-only indexes' table, change the `metadata.furniture` row to `metadata.furnished` with type `bool` under both `setup_qdrant_indexes` and (where it currently shows `bool`) `indexer`. In the 'Important discrepancies' bullet list, REMOVE the bullet that begins `- metadata.furniture (keyword, "Есть") is created by setup_qdrant_indexes.py, while indexer.py and setup_binary_collection.py create metadata.furnished (bool)...`. Add a new short subsection titled `### Furnished status (issue #1401)` immediately after the 'Important discrepancies' list. The subsection must state: (a) document/CSV pipeline canonical = `metadata.furnished` BOOL, (b) standalone apartments collection canonical = top-level `is_furnished` BOOL, (c) runtime filter producers (FilterExtractor, QueryAnalyzer prompt, query_filter_signal) emit `furnished: bool`, and (d) a one-paragraph migration note: existing deployments may carry a dead `metadata.furniture` KEYWORD index — it has zero data hits since the ingester writes `metadata.furnished` BOOL, and operators may delete it via `client.delete_payload_index(collection_name, 'metadata.furniture')` at any time; running setup_qdrant_indexes.py against an existing collection is idempotent and will create `metadata.furnished` BOOL only if absent.

(Cross-check, step 1) Search-only sanity sweep with `rg -n 'metadata\.furniture|filters\["furniture"\]|furniture.*string|furniture.*Есть'` over telegram_bot, src, scripts, tests, docs. The only remaining hits should be: (i) the regex/identifier `_FURNITURE_RE` in query_filter_signal.py (linguistic pattern, intentional); (ii) any historical CHANGELOG/ADR entries (do not modify); (iii) any test fixture that documents the migration. If any production filter-builder still produces `metadata.furniture`, fix it. Record the rg output in the feature `findings` after the sweep.

(Cross-check, step 2) Confirm src/ingestion/chunker.py still maps the CSV column `Мебель` to dict key `furnished` (it should — do not change). Confirm src/ingestion/indexer.py still creates `metadata.furnished` BOOL (it should — do not change). These are the ground-truth writers; the fix only aligns the index creators and runtime filter producers to match what they already write.

(Verification) Run, in this order: (a) `uv run --python 3.12 pytest tests/unit/services/test_filter_extractor.py tests/unit/services/test_query_filter_signal.py tests/unit/services/test_setup_qdrant_indexes.py tests/unit/services/test_query_analyzer_prompt.py tests/unit/scripts/test_apartments_setup_collection.py -q --timeout=30` and confirm 0 failures. (b) `uv run ruff check telegram_bot/ src/ tests/unit/services/ scripts/` for any new lint regressions. (c) `uv run mypy src/ telegram_bot/ --ignore-missing-imports --no-error-summary`. (d) Full fast lane: `PYTEST_ADDOPTS='-n auto --dist=worksteal' make test-unit`. Capture each summary line into `findings`. Explicitly list, under `findings`, every check that was deliberately skipped (e.g., docker compose, smoke, integration, e2e — all skipped per verify:repo-only label) so a reviewer can see the coverage envelope without re-deriving it.
acceptance_criteria: telegram_bot/setup_qdrant_indexes.py creates `metadata.furnished` with `models.PayloadSchemaType.BOOL` and contains zero references to `metadata.furniture`.
telegram_bot/services/filter_extractor.py.extract_filters returns the key `furnished` with bool value (True for positive phrasing, False for negative phrasing) and never returns the key `furniture`.
telegram_bot/services/query_analyzer.py.SYSTEM_PROMPT mentions `furnished` and `bool` and does not mention `furniture (string)`.
telegram_bot/services/query_filter_signal.detect_filter_sensitive_query emits the reason string `furnished` (not `furniture`) when the query contains furniture phrasing.
tests/unit/services/test_filter_extractor.py::TestFilterExtractorFurniture covers both positive (True) and negative (False) phrasing and asserts the new key name.
tests/unit/services/test_query_filter_signal.py asserts the reason `furnished` for furniture-mentioning queries.

docs/QDRANT_STACK.md no longer contains the 'metadata.furniture (keyword, "Есть") ... metadata.furnished (bool)' divergence bullet, contains a new 'Furnished status (issue #1401)' subsection that documents the per-collection canonical and the migration note, and the 'Structured Catalog / CSV-only indexes' table reflects `metadata.furnished` BOOL for `setup_qdrant_indexes`.

src/ingestion/chunker.py and src/ingestion/indexer.py are unchanged (the fix only aligns index creators and runtime filter producers to what these writers already produce). scripts/apartments/* and telegram_bot/services/apartments_service.py are unchanged (apartments collection lane is already consistent).
All commands listed in `verification` exit 0 and the captured summary lines are recorded under `findings`.

rg -n 'metadata\.furniture|filters\["furniture"\]' telegram_bot src scripts tests docs  # must return zero production-code hits
